topic: Why free AI tools beat expensive subscriptions
title: He canceled his $200 AI subscription and got better results 😲😲
description: Paid AI tools quietly throttle your speed and cap your usage, while free open-source models get updated weekly by thousands of developers. Here is why the free stack now beats the premium one.
pinned_comment: Grab the free AI tool stack I use instead of subscriptions in my bio 👇 Comment 'FREE' and I'll send it!
